title: Best script
features:
Farming
- Auto collect, deliver, place and hatch eggs when they’re ready.
- Egg priority options: Fast Cycle, Best Value or Nearest. Routes take the egg timer and travel distance into account, so it’s not just chasing whatever egg looks good.
- Auto collect pet earnings and feed pets with consumption confirmation.
- Auto fill empty plot slots with your heaviest held pets first. Pets already placed stay where they are.
- Separate Egg Loop, Pet Loop, Progress Loop and Smart All presets. Or just switch on the bits you want.
Shops, rewards and progression
- Server auto-buy for your chosen food and gear, plus manual buy controls and radar activation.
- Auto hatch-luck upgrades, affordable nest unlocks and rebirth when the requirements are met.
- Auto claims for eligible index, group, event and offline rewards.
Player and utility
- Speed, jump, fly, noclip, gravity and FOV controls; egg, pet and player ESP.
- Fullbright and particle-only FPS mode.
- Plot and shop shortcuts, prompt controls, lantern placement and game audio settings.
- Optional Anti AFK, Anti Kick, telemetry blocking, movement-read spoofing and auto rejoin.
